auth_domain.Description: The domain to authenticate users with when using App Engine's User API.

code_bucket.Description: The GCS bucket code is being stored in for this app.

default_bucket.Description: The GCS bucket content is being stored in for this app.

default_hostname.Description: The default hostname for this app.

feature_settings.Description: A block of optional settings to configure specific App Engine features:

gcr_domain.Description: The GCR domain used for storing managed Docker images for this app.

iap.Description: Settings for enabling Cloud Identity Aware Proxy

enabled.Description: Adapted for use with the app

oauth2_client_id.Description: OAuth2 client ID to use for the authentication flow.

oauth2_client_secret.Description: OAuth2 client secret to use for the authentication flow. The SHA-256 hash of the value is returned in the oauth2ClientSecretSha256 field.

oauth2_client_secret_sha256.Description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the client secret.

location_id.Description: The location to serve the app from.

project.Description: The project ID to create the application under.

serving_status.Description: The serving status of the app.

url_dispatch_rule.Description: A list of dispatch rule blocks. Each block has a domain, path, and service field.
